Context: 6. Proceedings after Retirement

holding a full-fledged inquiry, final orders will be passed in the name of the President, after due consultation with the UPSC. If in such proceedings the Disciplinary Authority comes to the conclusion that action under the rule is not justified, it is within the full competence of such authority to drop the proceedings initiated by him. - Rule 8 (2) (a) and GID thereunder.
